## To conclude...

- Data science is hard in practice! 
- Pre-processing and feature engineering should be part of the pipeline
- Leakage and other failures are always a risk, and complex pre-processing is more
error prone

## How skrub helps with that {.smaller}

- skrub transformers are scikit-learn compatible and handle most typical pre-processing
    - `Cleaner` and `TableVectorizer`
- they can be customized to fit most use cases
    - `SingleColumnTransformer`, `selectors`
- Data Ops extend the pipeline guarantees to multi-inputs, sample filtering, †arget construction ... 

And more! 

- The `TableReport` helps with data exploration and measuring statistics
- The selectors give total control over which columns should be modified and how
